name: AI Index
status: NOT IN FORCE — draft rulebook (quadrix/docs/methodology/qai.md), no inception decision anchored; the workflow step is disabled (if: false) and nothing is appended to trackrecord/

source.ownerDecisionDate: 2026-09-22 (paper index starts on the full universe, non-EVM names included; holdability is a column, not a screen)

universe.definition: tokens both classification sources carry as AI on the run day
universe.sourcePair: CoinMarketCap AI-family tag union INTERSECT CoinGecko category `artificial-intelligence` or `ai-agents` (qai.md §1). Both must agree on the run day.

chainRule.note: qai.md §1 (owner 2026-09-22 evening): a name carrying CMC `layer-1` is excluded unless it also carries `generative-ai` or `ai-agents` — the chain itself has to be the AI product. TAO stays (layer-1 + generative-ai); NEAR and ICP leave (layer-1 + ai-big-data only). `ai-big-data` alone is never grounds for a chain token. Same shape as qDEFI's 'chains out, HYPE exception'.

universe.holdability: informational only (qai.md §1, owner 2026-09-22): originChain / holdableOnGiwa are disclosure columns on every member row and never gate membership. The paper index holds non-EVM names.
universe.instrumentExclusions: qX20 rulebook §3 categories in full (stablecoins, yield-bearing stables, wrapped/bridged listings, LSD/LRT wrappers, LP/vault shares, exchange tokens, tokenized RWA shares) plus qAI-specific named exclusions in keeper/rulebooks/qai-exclusions.json (§3: wrapped/bridged by issuer, staking and subnet derivatives, AI-tagged memecoins)

rankBuffer.note: qai.md §6 inherits qDEFI's convention: entry at ⌊0.85N⌋ = 8, exit kept while rank ≤ ⌈1.25N⌉ = 13. Untested for this index (qai.md appendix B, D7).

exitHysteresis.note: qai.md §6: no grace quarter, same as qDEFI — a name failing eligibility or falling past exitMinRank leaves at that reconstitution.

weighting.rejected: √market-cap and equal weighting were compared across qAI/qDEFI/qX20 and not adopted (qai.md §4, docs/research/ai/weighting-study.md). Not to be re-proposed.

cap.method: immediate hard trim to cap at reconstitution, excess redistributed pro rata among uncapped names, iterated to convergence; a residue with nowhere left to go is NOT redistributed — it is held as cash (qai.md §5/§6). This differs from qREV/qDEFI's applyCap, which raises the cap to 1/n rather than leaving a residue.

cash.emptySeatsAndCapResidue: held as cash at a constant 1.0 unit price, no interest (qai.md §6, D8 draft = 0%). Not the Barbell/Triens DTB3 proxy.
cash.note: qai.md §12-1: a quarter with zero eligible names is recorded as 100% cash, not as a missing day. The backtest's 2023-Q1 quarter was exactly that.

reconstitution.rule: first run after 00:00 UTC on Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1 (same dates as qREV/qDEFI)

tolerance.rule: a name whose target weight differs from its drifted (mark-to-market) weight by less than 5 percentage points is NOT traded at reconstitution; cash is treated as one more position for this test, as the research engine does
tolerance.capOverride: any name whose drifted weight is above 35% is ALWAYS cut to 35% regardless of the 5-point tolerance

reconstitution.betweenReconstitutions: no trading; the book is only marked to market daily. No drift band (qai.md §7).

specialEvents.note: qai.md §9 points at qX20 §9 (fallback source → at most 3 runs at the last known price → 0 valuation, anchored decision). Not implemented in this pass, same as qREV/qDEFI.

sectorClassification.primary: CoinMarketCap public data-api `cryptocurrency/listing` (unauthenticated, top 1000 by market cap, `tags` array) — the same public listing family the research used (docs/research/ai/fetch-cmc-weekly.py). No CMC_API_KEY secret exists in this repository.
sectorClassification.fallback: none — if EITHER source is unreachable the membership is frozen at the last reconstitution (qai.md §8). Two quarters frozen is a §12 condition.

marketCapPriceVolume.primary: CoinGecko coins/markets — the two AI category pulls carry price/market cap/volume/ath/atl for every candidate, and the top-500 pull covers the rest of the book

buckets.fallback: tag-priority classification for a symbol the table does not cover; the member row then carries bucketSource `tag-fallback`

disclosure._doc: Buckets are a DISCLOSURE column, never a rule (qai.md §1, owner 2026-09-22: the bucket cap was a worker proposal and was not adopted). originChain / holdableOnGiwa likewise: informational, never a screen. Table copied from docs/research/ai/ai-bucket-map.csv joined to ai-universe.csv, 2026-09-22 snapshot; a change to it is a rule change under §10 and needs an anchored decision.

basket._doc: No basket and no vault. qai.md §12-3: a vault is not built while fewer than 5 eligible names can be held on GIWA — today's top names are non-EVM. The paper record runs without one.
